entries.title: Meet with Mountain State Spotlight in the Eastern Panhandle
entries.summary: Mountain State Spotlight is visiting communities in Morgan, Berkeley and Jefferson County October 10-13, 2023.
entries.content:
Next month, Mountain State Spotlight will spend a few days in the Eastern Panhandle on a listening tour to inform our coverage of the issues that matter to you.

We want to hear from residents about what issues matter to them, and how the news media does in its mission to provide residents the information they need.

Over the last few weeks, we’ve heard from dozens of readers in Morgan, Berkeley and Jefferson counties who shared story ideas, hot-button issues and don’t-miss spots in their communities.

From October 10-12 we will be in the Eastern Panhandle — and we want to meet you!

We at Mountain State Spotlight are on a mission to hear from people from around the state, in the places they call home.

We want to make sure our reporting reflects the readers we serve. And that includes you, your family and your community.

Click on an event below to learn more and RSVP.

Where we’ll be in the Eastern Panhandle:

Tuesday, Oct. 10 — Berkeley Springs

5:30 – 7 p.m. at The Lazy Sundae

Wednesday, Oct. 11 — Martinsburg

8:30 – 10 a.m. at Community Cup Coffee and More

Thursday, Oct. 12 — Charles Town, Shepherdstown

8 – 9:30 a.m. at Sibling Coffee Roasters in Charles Town

2:30 – 4:30 p.m. at Shepherdstown Public Library in Shepherdstown
